name: ESO 272-G025 (Hubble)
blurb: ESO 272-G025, a dwarf irregular galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: eso272g025-hubble
story: A small irregular galaxy on the outskirts of the Centaurus A group, its hydrogen gas gathered around a bright, compact body of stars. Hubble visited it in a survey of every known nearby galaxy, picking out its brightest stars to measure how far away it lies.

claims.text: ESO 272-G025 (HIPASS J1443-44) is a dwarf irregular galaxy in the outskirts of the Cen A group
Its hydrogen (HI) gas is centered on a bright, compact optical body
ESO-272-25 is a target of HST program 15922 'Every Known Nearby Galaxy'
Program 15922 images nearby galaxies to resolve their brightest stars and measure tip-of-the-red-giant-branch distances
